data.name: Maqbuli
data.gender_notes: Maqbuli is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Maqbuli is derived from the Arabic root 'qabala' which means 'to accept'. This name signifies someone who is accepted and pleasing to Allah. It is mentioned in the Quran that Allah will accept the repentance of those who turn to Him and do righteous deeds (Quran 2:267). The name Maqbuli carries the meaning “Accepted, Pleasing to Allah” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Maqbuli usually hope their child will grow to embody accepted, pleasing to allah and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name that symbolizes Allah's acceptance and mercy.
data.etymology: Maqbuli belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Accepted, Pleasing to Allah.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Maqbuli total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.

in_arabic.name: مقبولي
in_arabic.meaning: اسم مشتق من القبول، المقبول عند الله
in_arabic.long_meaning: مقبولي هو اسم علم مذكر من أصل عربي، مشتق من الفعل 'قَبِلَ' الذي يعني قبول الشيء أو الشخص. هذا الاسم يحمل معنى الشخص المقبول عند الله، أو الذي يحظى بالقبول في الدنيا والآخرة. يعتبر هذا الاسم من الأسماء التي تعبر عن الصفات الحميدة والمرغوبة في الشخص المسلم، حيث يأمل الوالدان أن يكون ابنهم مقبولاً عند الله وعند الناس.

in_urdu.name: مقبولی
in_urdu.long_meaning: مقبولی ایک مذکر نام ہے جو عربی زبان سے ماخوذ ہے۔ اس کا مطلب ہے وہ شخص جو اللہ کے نزدیک مقبول ہو، یا جس کو لوگ اور اللہ تعالیٰ قبول کرتے ہیں۔ یہ نام مسلمان والدین کے لیے اہم ہے کیونکہ وہ اپنے بچے کے لیے ایسی صفات کی دعا کرتے ہیں جو اللہ اور لوگوں کے سامنے قابل قبول ہوں۔

in_hindi.name: मकबूली

in_english.name: Maqbuli
in_english.long_meaning: Maqbuli is a masculine name of Arabic origin. It means 'accepted by God' or 'one who is accepted by people and Allah'. The name is derived from the Arabic root 'q-b-l', which means 'to accept'. In Islamic tradition, Maqbuli is considered a name that embodies desirable qualities, reflecting the hope that the bearer will be accepted and loved by both God and people. Historically, the name has been used across various Muslim cultures, symbolizing spiritual aspirations and moral virtues.

historical_references.reference: Ibn Khaldun's Muqaddimah: The Islamic History and Civilization, translated by Franz Rosenthal, Princeton University Press, 1967.
historical_references.context: In his influential work 'Muqaddimah', Ibn Khaldun (1332-1406) wrote about the rise and fall of dynasties in the Islamic world. He described the Banu Maqbuli as a Berber dynasty that ruled in the Maghreb (North Africa) from 1236 to 1352 AD. Ibn Khaldun attributed the fall of the Maqbuli to their excessive luxury and disregard for Islamic law.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Al-Maqrizi's Al-Mawāqiş al-ʿūlā, translated by Roemer, G. H. A. et al., Brill, 1993. The name Maqbuli carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: Al-Maqrizi (1364-1442) in his monumental work 'Al-Mawāqiş al-ʿūlā' (The Useful Knowledge) described the Maqbulids as a Berber dynasty ruling Algeria from the second half of the 13th century to the late 15th century. He mentioned their rich cultural legacy, including their patronage of scholars and the construction of prominent mosques and madrasas.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Maqbool, derived from the Arabic word 'maqbul' meaning 'accepted' or 'welcome', has seen a modern resurgence in popularity among Muslims around the world. This name is often given to newborn boys as a sign of hope and positivity, reflecting the belief that Allah will accept the child into His mercy. On platforms such as Instagram, Facebook, and Pinterest, there are numerous pages and groups dedicated to Islamic traditions and naming customs, where Maqbool is frequently featured in posts, photos, and discussions. These platforms provide a space for Muslims to connect, share their experiences, and celebrate their identity, making Maqbool a fashionable and relevant name within the modern Muslim community.
